_notes.purpose: Used by the SA engine to price proposals competitively against typical market rates for similar government/enterprise IT engagements.
_notes.methodology: Blended bill rates (fully-loaded, includes overhead/margin) set at the competitive-bid midpoint of 2026 published US market benchmarks for each role, adjusted slightly down from top-tier/independent-consultant rates since bids are won on being competitive, not maximal. These are NOT actual competitor rates (not observable pre-award) — they are defensible market estimates for the SA/leadership to validate and adjust per engagement.
sources: Aristek Consulting IT Consulting Hourly Rates 2026
_notes.review_cadence: Recommend SA/leadership review and update quarterly, or immediately if won/lost bid data suggests drift.

pricing_rules.note: Add contingency buffer to total labor estimate for scope-refinement risk. Present as a single visible line item, never hidden inside role rates.
